allocation_note: System allocation requests incl realloc; cumulative allocated bytes, not resident/peak memory

conditions.load: Cargo/source gate serializes Rust workloads; no claim that all unrelated host processes were idle

normalization_work_accounting: Actual normalizer rewrite delimiter bytes, rewrite iterations, constant name checks, identifier scans and successful name copying. Other public normalization stages are fixed linear passes; count is a work proxy, not CPU instructions.
